items.summary: Needs a Lead ruling. After F, 67 Related-header entries in 59 docs/platform files still name move-set source paths (pre-L13-26 there were also 67, so this commit neither causes nor fixes them). The product doc checker (scripts/check-doc-candidate-status.mjs relatedPaths -> unresolved-related; check-doc-retirement.mjs counts it as a link) reads Related values inside the ```txt header fence. L13-21.4 treated 9 Related-header entries as link rows. L13-26 and linkIntoMoveSet cover only clickable links, so the ruling's premise that F passes a strict link guard is not met for Related headers. Some of these are deliberate custody spellings in history wrappers (shard-2 reasons), so the decision belongs to the Lead, not this Doer: either extend L13-26 rows and linkIntoMoveSet to header Related values, or rule that the cutover guard 3 does not read Related in history wrappers.
